user.title: Compare electricity tariffs
user.description: Each option is priced on the sensor's last 12 months of hourly statistics, with the regulated tariffs (incl. taxes) published by the CRE and in force each day.

data_description.entite_energie: The sensor used in the Energy dashboard (Linky meter, clamp, etc.).
data_description.heures_creuses: Ranges shown on the bill or the distribution network operator's customer area (Enedis or local operator), e.g. "22:00-06:00" or "02:00-07:00, 13:00-16:00". Used to simulate the off-peak option even if your current option is Base. If they changed during the year, add each change after "|" with its date: "22:00-06:00 | 2026-03-15: 02:00-07:00, 13:00-16:00". Different summer (1 April – 31 October) and winter (1 November – 31 March) ranges: "été 02:00-07:00, 13:00-16:00 / hiver 23:00-07:00" ("summer" / "winter" also accepted).
data_description.index_hc: Cumulative energy sensor of the meter's off-peak index, from a teleinfo module (network operator index, not a supplier calendar). With the peak index, off-peak ranges are detected over the 12 months, changes included, and replace the typed ranges.
data_description.index_hp: Cumulative energy sensor of the meter's peak index (teleinfo). Fill in together with the off-peak index.

error.unite: The sensor must be in Wh, kWh or MWh.
error.state_class: The sensor must be cumulative (state_class total or total_increasing), like Energy dashboard sensors.
error.plages_invalides: Unreadable ranges: HH:MM-HH:MM, comma-separated, no overlap; changes: "| YYYY-MM-DD: ranges", increasing dates; seasons: "été … / hiver …".
error.index_par_paire: Fill in both indexes (off-peak and peak), or neither.
error.index_identiques: The off-peak and peak indexes must be two different sensors.
